records.title: Registry Orientation & Information Radiator
records.readerJob: Select a fitting Registry family when the current technical or collaboration concern has no clear home.
records.localFallback: Classify the current concern from repository source and select one route from the cold-session entry runbook.
records.reentryCondition: Reload the Registry router when no local route names the current concern or the source-family standing changes.

records.title: Practitioner Probes
records.readerJob: Select the smallest technical layer or cross-cutting concern that can change the implementation or review decision.
records.localFallback: Name one practical question, its mechanism, the observation that can answer it, and the receiving use before forming source.
records.reentryCondition: Reload the family when a different technical layer or cross-cutting concern can change the selected route.

records.title: Start Here — How to Use the Probes
records.readerJob: Use probe anatomy, technical-veracity standing, review surfaces, and instruction yield as one bounded technical judgment route.
records.localFallback: Carry the practical question, technical core, review surface, veracity standing, and instruction yield into one reviewable artifact decision.
records.reentryCondition: Reload this orientation when probe anatomy or technical-veracity vocabulary changes the artifact contract.

records.title: Cross-Cutting — Verification Under AI Assistance
records.readerJob: Connect plausible AI-assisted output with named contracts, distinguishing checks, and evidence-calibrated acceptance.
records.localFallback: Pair each asserted behavior with a source mechanism, plausible contrast, observable oracle, and explicit evidence boundary.
records.reentryCondition: Reload the source when a new AI-assisted failure shape or acceptance boundary changes the fitting observation.

records.title: Behavior- and Goal-Driven Development — Verifiable Outcomes & Testable Loops
records.readerJob: Define the desired behavior, plausible failure, distinguishing oracle, and stable adjacent behavior before broad implementation.
records.localFallback: State one changed ability, one consequential contrast, and the smallest observation that can distinguish the intended result.
records.reentryCondition: Reload the source when acceptance remains plausible but insufficiently observable.

records.title: Data Contract Integrity & Primitive Selection — Start Here
records.readerJob: Choose primitives and state meanings that survive serialization, schema evolution, storage, and migration boundaries.
records.localFallback: Name each state and primitive meaning before selecting its wire, schema, storage, or migration representation.
records.reentryCondition: Reload the source when a receiving boundary collapses states or creates new shared schema pressure.

records.title: Cross-Cutting — Replay & Idempotency
records.readerJob: Distinguish first acceptance, exact replay, changed meaning, active ownership, and post-publication recovery.
records.localFallback: Define semantic identity and recorded outcome, then exercise exact replay, changed meaning, and response loss as distinct states.
records.reentryCondition: Reload the source when retry meaning, publication timing, or recovery ownership changes.

records.title: Cross-Cutting — Serialization Boundary Integrity
records.readerJob: Keep meaning, validation, trust, and failure ownership legible across a wire-format boundary.
records.localFallback: Name admitted meanings, rejected shapes, validation ownership, and the observation that proves the wire round trip.
records.reentryCondition: Reload the source when another serializer, transport, or trust boundary changes the admitted state space.

records.title: Cross-Cutting — Declared State ≠ Running State
records.readerJob: Separate declared configuration, remembered state, generated projection, and observed runtime behavior.
records.localFallback: Map authored declaration, accepted source, generated bytes, delivery state, and observed response as distinct coordinates.
records.reentryCondition: Reload the source when a declaration and its running or delivered state diverge.

records.title: Cross-Cutting — Ownership & Ordering
records.readerJob: Identify the owner, order, serialization point, and evidence boundary for shared state and concurrent work.
records.localFallback: Name each actor, accepted pre-state, aligned effect, publication point, and forced-overlap observation.
records.reentryCondition: Reload the source when actor count, ordering, or coordination authority changes.

records.title: Material Verification — Connect Checks to Behavior, Fault & Observable Evidence
records.readerJob: Connect a check with the behavior, plausible fault, oracle, and decision it can materially distinguish.
records.localFallback: State what each check establishes first, then route the adjacent claim to its fitting source or observation.
records.reentryCondition: Reload the source when a passing check leaves the material acceptance question unresolved.

records.title: Prototype Standing & Synthetic Fixture Honesty — Evidence Before Appearance
records.readerJob: Keep demonstration quality, synthetic-fixture provenance, technical evidence, and production standing distinct.
records.localFallback: Name fixture provenance, technical-veracity standing, demonstrated behavior, and the receiving environment that owns production claims.
records.reentryCondition: Reload the source when presentation quality could be mistaken for a stronger evidence or deployment standing.

records.title: Source Authority & Access Mapping — Evidence Coverage Before Synthesis
records.readerJob: Trace a claim through semantic owner, source, projection, delivery, access, and receiving use before synthesis.
records.localFallback: Map source, artifact contract, registry discovery, generated projection, delivery, and publication as separate owners.
records.reentryCondition: Reload the source when an unavailable source or changed access boundary can alter the synthesis.

records.title: Publication Boundaries and Proportionate Review
records.readerJob: Match audience change, source standing, review depth, and disclosure to the material publication consequence.
records.localFallback: Treat source acceptance, immutable identity, Pages projection, hosted delivery, and optional Gist creation as separately granted actions.
records.reentryCondition: Reload the source when audience, disclosure, publication carrier, or approval standing changes.

records.title: Repository Re-Entry
records.readerJob: Recover current source and collaboration standing when connector-resolved lineage materially changes the route.
records.localFallback: Let current Git, GitHub, runnable source, and generated manifests lead while planning retains prospective context.
records.reentryCondition: Reload the external source when private lineage changes a current owner or next move that repository evidence cannot resolve.

records.title: Goal Fidelity Under Partial Context
records.readerJob: Keep checks, catalogs, validators, and collaboration machinery proportional to the receiving behavior or decision.
records.localFallback: Select the smallest source change and observation that create the named receiving ability, then release adjacent machinery.
records.reentryCondition: Reload the source when supporting machinery begins to outgrow the material receiving job.

records.title: Proportionate Recovery Routing — Smallest Adequate Move, Verified Return
records.readerJob: Select the smallest adequate recovery move and preserve one verified return after stale context, source loss, or authority confusion.
records.localFallback: Return to the last verified source coordinate, name the missing signal, and continue through the smallest owner that can establish it.
records.reentryCondition: Reload the source when repeated recovery work reveals a materially different failure geometry.

records.title: Semantic Attractor Design — Negation-Aware Instructions
records.readerJob: Lead instructions with the desired verifiable state and pair load-bearing safety or privacy boundaries with their replacement behavior.
records.localFallback: State the desired behavior directly, preserve meaningful boundaries, and lead each evidence statement with what the observation establishes.
records.reentryCondition: Reload the source when instruction polarity or a recurring failure token changes collaborator behavior.

records.title: Designing AI Skills as Situated Collaboration Affordances
records.readerJob: Assess whether a recurring collaboration job has earned a portable skill contract and a complete dependency closure.
records.localFallback: Use the current skill catalog, keep one result owner, and form a new route only when a distinct trigger, result, and completion recur.
records.reentryCondition: Reload the source when changing a repository skill or preparing a transferable public package.

records.title: AI Collaboration Runbooks — Known Paths, Bounded Authority & Calm Return
records.readerJob: Shape a settled multi-phase route with explicit entry, authority, evidence, recovery, stop, and handback.
records.localFallback: Lead with the desired receiving state, then name entry, owners, phases, checks, recovery, stop, and one safe handback.
records.reentryCondition: Reload the source when a known route changes owners, phases, or recovery semantics.

records.title: FMI & Genomic Re-Platforming Visitor Depth — Cross-Platform Collaboration Docket
records.readerJob: Coordinate a Context Canvas mechanism with an independently authored, domain-neutral, exact-version Gist Registry sample.
records.localFallback: Keep the Registry sample independently authored, synthetic, domain-neutral, runnable, exact-versioned, and bounded by its own evidence.
records.reentryCondition: Reload the authorized overlay when a Context Canvas receiving page or neutral-sample contract changes.

records.title: Tranche 02 — Pair Visitor Depth with Neutral Gist-Registry Samples
records.expectedParentTitle: FMI & Genomic Re-Platforming Visitor Depth — Cross-Platform Collaboration Docket
records.readerJob: Apply the neutral-sample contract to one named visitor mechanism and preserve separate source and publication authority.
records.localFallback: Name the visitor mechanism, form a neutral standalone artifact, establish its runnable evidence, and leave placement and publication with their receiving owners.
records.reentryCondition: Reload the authorized tranche when a named visitor receiver is ready to accept a Registry coordinate.

profiles.title: Artifact formation
profiles.readerJob: Form a first reviewable coordinate with a practical question, focused evidence, honest standing, and one receiving use.
profiles.selectionRule: Load the core four, then select the smallest additional record whose mechanism can change the artifact shape or evidence boundary.

profiles.title: Cold-session core
profiles.readerJob: Begin from a compact technical judgment and verification footing before selecting one contribution route.
profiles.selectionRule: Load these four records when workspace context can change the decision; use their local fallbacks while connector context rests.

profiles.title: Context Canvas neutral sample
profiles.readerJob: Pair one visitor mechanism with a separately authoritative, neutral Registry sample through an authorized cross-platform route.
profiles.selectionRule: Use only when authorized workspace access and a named Context Canvas receiver are both present.

profiles.title: Public handoff
profiles.readerJob: Prepare an accepted source or named artifact for a separately granted audience change.
profiles.selectionRule: Load the publication and source-authority records, then use the repository-owned secret and Pages routes for actual handoff evidence.

profiles.title: Runnable transaction exemplar
profiles.readerJob: Make identity, aligned effects, ordering, publication, replay, and recovery observable in one runnable artifact.
profiles.selectionRule: Load only the records whose failure interval or evidence owner can change the current transaction contract.

profiles.title: Skill and runbook authoring
profiles.readerJob: Shape a reusable collaboration method while current source, authority, and receiving work retain priority.
profiles.selectionRule: Load when the task explicitly changes reusable instruction routing; ordinary source work continues through repository-local skills and runbooks.
